The byte-size guard records file-level shapeAllow entries by design; inspection of the current file confirms these consumers produce numeric resource telemetry for numeric threshold decisions, with no formatting/string output. No current broader drift or display-formatter bypass was found. Revisit the census if display formatting is later added to this file.
